reason: Semantics hold on every path. Entries: fall-through from sfx_output.amplitude, JSR sfx_write (tone low byte, noise), JSR/BRA sfx_write.ddra_set_c046b (tone high byte, tone amplitude), BRA sfx_write from sfx_next_ramp.ended (sfx_tick's request and ramp-end paths, sfx_silence's loop); no label+N, address table or external reference to wait_high or the moved labels (grep src/ tools/). Exits, all one RTS: Y = 0 both ways (wait_low leaves 0; LDA #8 does not touch Y; old wait_high also ended at 0), X, C, V untouched both ways, stack identical. A differs (written byte -> &08) and Z differs (1 -> 0): every consumer overwrites both before reading - sfx_output reloads A (LDA sfx_p_hi / LDA sfx_v), sfx_tick goes to LDA sfx_dp,X or DEX/BPL then LDA, its RTS returns to irq1_handler which PLAs, sfx_silence DEX/BPL then PLP (flags restored) and its two bank 5 callers reload A (LDA #&FF / CLI then JMP clear_title_screen after LDA? - give_irq_back: CLI, JMP; take_irq_for_play: LDA #&FF). VIA state at exit identical (DDRA &FF, ORA the byte, latch line 0 high written with the same value &08). Interrupts: sfx_write runs only in irq1_handler or under sfx_silence's SEI, so nothing interleaves; a main-program keydown_int interrupted mid-sequence sees the same ORA/DDRA as before. Timing at the chip: WE-low time (wait_low) unchanged; rise to the next ORA write is >= 31 cycles (tone high->amplitude: RTS 6, LDA abs,X 4, 4 LSR 8, EOR 2, ORA abs,X 4, BRA 3, STA 4), next WE fall later still, longer than the MOS's own post-rise delay; after sfx_silence returns, the MOS's next chip write comes after DEX/BPL/PLP/RTS/CLI and an IRQ entry. The 5-byte slide of .noise, sfx_silence, the sfx tables, sfx_data, compiled_bank5 and credits is label-relative everywhere (sfx_next_ramp's inline reads compute page+offset+Y with absolute,Y carry; noise_written's sentinel is a high byte >= &A5, still never 0-7); its page-crossing cycles and the 'no data moves' rule are for the machine and project lenses.
